question: System 1 is best described as which of the following?
options: Fast, automatic, effortless processing system that generates intuitive judgments
Slow, deliberate, and effortful analytical system
A system that performs complex computations only when needed
A system that focuses solely on emotional responses
correct_answer_text: Fast, automatic, effortless processing system that generates intuitive judgments
